question: Padma Vibhushan award of 2022 has not been given in which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Padma Vibhushan award is the second-highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional and distinguished service in various fields.
 
• In 2022, the Padma Vibhushan award was conferred in various fields including Civil Service, Literature and Education, and Art.
 
• Trade and Industry was not one of the fields in which the Padma Vibhushan award was given in 2022.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Vibhushan award are announced annually on Republic Day and the awards are conferred by the President of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**:

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, instituted in 1954.
 
• They are categorized into three awards: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• The awards recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
 
 
 
• **Fields Recognized**:
 
 
• Fields include Art, Literature and Education, Civil Service, Public Affairs, Science and Engineering, Trade and Industry, Medicine, Social Work, and others.
 
• The awards aim to recognize 'work of distinction' and are given for distinguished and exceptional achievements/service in all fields of activities/disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Selection Process**:
 
 
• The Padma Awards Committee is constituted by the Prime Minister every year.
 
• The recommendations for the Padma Awards are submitted to the Padma Awards Committee and the final list is approved by the Prime Minister and the President of India.
 
 
 
• **Award Ceremony**:
 
 
• The awards are announced on the occasion of Republic Day every year and are conferred by the President of India at ceremonial functions held at Rashtrapati Bhavan usually around March/April.
